public_holidays: 2027-10-19 (Tuesday): Dia do Piauí, state holiday (Lei estadual 176/1937)
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here.
